source.reference: User PonyLumen export + public original animation data
source.status: EQN-GO mod source. Build report and runtime evidence distinguish static validation, game loading and combat testing.
source.creator: PonyLumen / original model and animation contributors

hero.comparison: Mammalian S3 corvette body: 13.094 units; Heart body: 11.130 units (85%), excluding horn, wings and hair.
hero.weaponSummary: 65 horn weapons: 4 T · 12 X · 16 L · 12 M · 8 S · 8 P · 4 G · 1 W
hero.defenseSummary: 24 L utility · 12 auxiliary; staged crystal reactors
hero.weaponOrigin: Every offensive slot shares the animated horn muzzle
hero.groundRole: The same three bodies can switch between space and ground through a decision on any owned colony in the ship's system. The resulting assault army can embark and invade hostile planets.
hero.planetKiller: One native W-slot crystal planet cracker fires from the animated horn. Charge is five times faster than the vanilla World Cracker, while the full firing sequence remains visible.
hero.materialSummary: Safe default: all five material groups are fully opaque with crystal effects disabled. The sandbox can independently configure gold, wings, eyes, cyan body/horn, and purple mane/tail; optional crystal shells never replace the stable base pass.
hero.validation: Flights A, B, and C retain Heart’s verified left-ear local rest transform across all 371 community frames; direct renders confirm both ears remain attached. A uses its native seven-beat Wing1/Wing2/Wing3 chain with bone-local rest-relative transfer, B remains a selectable native Genmaxx body-and-wing clip, and C discards its far-away source scene placement. Seven native animations passed 483 re-import bounds/locator checks (max error 0.0000210). Fast flight C is selected for native moving and combat_moving states; the rebuilt safe opaque asset still requires game runtime inspection.

groundArmy.implementationRequirement: Separate common/armies definition; scripted identity/deployment lifecycle if the same unique hero switches between ship and army.

integrationRequirements: Native ship size and section definitions with custom core component eligibility
Planet-killer component restrictions and dispatch hooks; native star-eater mixed-slot precedent inspected
Ground army definition and optional single-hero lifecycle
In-game visual/material, combat, planet-killer and invasion tests

clips.name: Fly · original idle
clips.description: Original Fly tracks, sampled from the creator source. Runtime hair jiggle is not included.

clips.name: Previous moving · adapted creator fly
clips.description: Original fly cycle shortened to 0.75 seconds; not a separately downloaded animation.

clips.name: Dash · authored variant
clips.description: Forward-leaning 0.5-second flight variant; not a separately downloaded dash.

clips.name: Fast flight A · native VA body + wings
clips.description: Native VA body-and-wing motion with live body, wing, and tail timing. Its source window contains seven wing beats. A’s Wing1 → Wing2 → Wing3 bone-local deltas are applied rest-relative to the selected PonyLumen large-wing rig; the left ear keeps Heart’s verified rest transform.

clips.name: Fast flight B · Genmaxx
clips.description: Selectable native Genmaxx body-and-wing flight. Its animated main wing chain drives Heart’s three large-wing joints through rest-relative rotation deltas, preserving the PonyLumen large-wing bind pose; independent feathers and facial controls are not reproduced. The verified Heart left-ear transform remains fixed.

clips.name: Fast flight C · Argodaemon
clips.description: User-supplied female fast-flight revision sampled from its ten-second animated interval. Source scene translation and global roll are removed so it plays upright and in place instead of leaving the preview camera. It is the default native moving and combat-moving animation. Heart’s verified left-ear rest transform is retained.

clips.name: Planet killer · idle flight pitched down 45°
clips.sourceFile: PonyLumen original Fly, whole rig pitched down for the W-slot firing state
clips.description: The original idle flying loop rotated 45 degrees toward the planet while the horn emits the accelerated planet-cracker beam.

mod.name: EQN-GO
mod.description: Princess Stellaris Heart, Robot Eevee and Krys Pony. Player-only origin with a researchable multi-body hero.

notes: Recovered 8 Robot Eevee, 78 Krys file entries and bonus Cadance; 85 unique images total.
Fixed legacy krys30.dds reference by preserving krys_30.dds.
Original species overrides deliberately replaced with namespaced classes.

origin.name: Princess Stellaris Heart
origin.description: Begin with Princess Stellaris Heart as your immortal ruler and as a separate immortal hero-ship commander. Develop her crystal body through royal and precursor technologies. Research two additional bodies, up to three total. Ground deployments use those same bodies.

traits.name: Crystal Princess
traits.description: An immortal royal mind. Fleet combat bonuses apply while she commands a fleet; army bonuses apply while she commands an invasion.

traits.name: Battlefield Harmony
traits.description: Her parallel senses coordinate horn fire and shield timing.

translations.EQN_EEVEE_desc: 机器人伊布——仅供玩家创建的帝国使用。
translations.EQN_KRYS_desc: Krys小马——仅供玩家创建的帝国使用。
translations.eqn_princess_desc: 永生的王室意识。亲自指挥舰队时获得舰队战斗加成；亲自指挥登陆作战时获得陆军加成。
translations.eqn_battle_harmony_desc: 她通过多个化身的同步感知，协调独角火力与护盾响应。
translations.origin_eqn_heart_desc: 开局由永生的星海公主统治国家，并拥有她的第二位永生英雄舰指挥官化身。通过王室与先驱科技强化她的水晶之躯，并研究两个额外化身，最多同时拥有三个。地面部署也使用这三个化身，同一化身不能同时以舰船和陆军形式存在。

translations.eqn_ground_1_desc: 公主的可运输进攻陆军化身。可在舰船所在星系的任意己方殖民地通过星球决议切换形态，成为陆军后可登船并登陆敌方星球。
translations.eqn_awaken_1_desc: 在首都创造第1个化身。该化身当前不能以舰船或陆军形式存在。
translations.eqn_space_1_desc: 将驻扎在任意己方殖民地的地面化身转化为英雄舰船。已登船的陆军必须先在己方殖民地登陆。
translations.eqn_ground_2_desc: 公主的可运输进攻陆军化身。可在舰船所在星系的任意己方殖民地通过星球决议切换形态，成为陆军后可登船并登陆敌方星球。
translations.eqn_awaken_2_desc: 在首都创造第2个化身。该化身当前不能以舰船或陆军形式存在。
translations.eqn_space_2_desc: 将驻扎在任意己方殖民地的地面化身转化为英雄舰船。已登船的陆军必须先在己方殖民地登陆。
translations.tech_eqn_body_2_desc: 解锁第2个化身。唤醒仍在首都进行；已有化身可在其所在星系的任意己方殖民地切换舰船或地面陆军形态。
translations.eqn_ground_3_desc: 公主的可运输进攻陆军化身。可在舰船所在星系的任意己方殖民地通过星球决议切换形态，成为陆军后可登船并登陆敌方星球。
translations.eqn_awaken_3_desc: 在首都创造第3个化身。该化身当前不能以舰船或陆军形式存在。
translations.eqn_space_3_desc: 将驻扎在任意己方殖民地的地面化身转化为英雄舰船。已登船的陆军必须先在己方殖民地登陆。
translations.tech_eqn_body_3_desc: 解锁第3个化身。唤醒仍在首都进行；已有化身可在其所在星系的任意己方殖民地切换舰船或地面陆军形态。
translations.eqn_deploy_ground_1_desc: 在任意己方殖民地，将同星系内状态完好的英雄舰船化身转化为可运输进攻陆军。之后让陆军登船，再右键敌方星球即可登陆。仍由同一位指挥官统率。
translations.eqn_deploy_ground_2_desc: 在任意己方殖民地，将同星系内状态完好的英雄舰船化身转化为可运输进攻陆军。之后让陆军登船，再右键敌方星球即可登陆。仍由同一位指挥官统率。
translations.eqn_deploy_ground_3_desc: 在任意己方殖民地，将同星系内状态完好的英雄舰船化身转化为可运输进攻陆军。之后让陆军登船，再右键敌方星球即可登陆。仍由同一位指挥官统率。

groundComparison.unitMeaning: 军队定义的damage、health、morale是倍率，不是最终伤害或生命值。

engine.regenNote: 定义只确认月度恢复常数；不要据此假设战斗中获得回血。基准战斗不额外修复或回血。

modRules.warning: ACOT与群星修仙传会改写陆军战力显示公式；战力数字不可直接换算为可击败的部队数量。

modifierFormula.stageWithCurrentTraits: Research bonus=M-1; current two traits sum to+0.5 health/damage, hence health/damage scale=M+0.5, before other species/country/skill/experience modifiers.
modifierFormula.moraleNote: 科技与公主特质同时提高士气；实际指挥官加成须由原生战斗验证。

groundComparison.validation: 理论比较；必须另附原生1对120地面战斗记录才能标记通过。
